verdict.rationale: Docs confirm code execution across multiple languages via SDKs, with both stateless snippet execution and stateful persistent interpreter contexts, plus rich supporting features (sandboxes, snapshots, terminal, CLI). No explicit mention of structured 'rich results' (e.g., charts/images) beyond persistent state, and no independent hands-on validation of multi-language execution quality. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of execution results across languages, explicit detail on rich output formats (images, tables, artifacts) returned from execution.
